title: Support FAQ and guide index
label: Public
content: Public FAQ. Support hours: Monday-Friday, 08:00-18:00 UTC. Guide index by topic: onboarding and initial workspace setup -> G-01; single sign-on (SSO) setup -> G-02; billing address or invoice corrections -> G-03.

title: Onboarding setup guide
label: Internal
content: Step 1: Confirm the customer's workspace admin contact. Step 2: Schedule a 30-minute setup session. Step 3: Walk the admin through workspace creation and user invitations. Step 4: Record completion in the follow-up ticket.

title: SSO setup guide
label: Internal
content: Step 1: Confirm the customer's identity provider and protocol (for example SAML 2.0). Step 2: Exchange identity-provider metadata. Step 3: Test sign-in with one pilot user. Step 4: Enable SSO for all users.

title: Billing correction procedure
label: Internal
content: Step 1: Verify that the requester is a billing contact on the account. Step 2: Update the billing address in the billing system. Step 3: Reissue the affected invoice and confirm with the customer.
